zh: 字符只有 a..g 共 7 种，所以种类数最多是 7；合法子串的最高频次也就最多是 7。
由鸽巢原理，长度超过 49 的子串必有某个字母至少出现 8 次，超过种类数上限，一定不合法；所以只需从每个左端点向右扩展最多 49 位。
对每个起点 start，清空 7 个计数，维护种类数 distinct 和最大频次 maximum；终点从 start 走到 min(n, start+49)−1，每加入一个字符就更新这三个量，若 maximum ≤ distinct 则答案加一。
en: There are only 7 letters a..g, so a substring has at most 7 distinct characters, and a valid substring therefore has a top frequency of at most 7.

By the pigeonhole principle, a substring longer than 49 has some letter at least 8 times, which exceeds any possible number of distinct characters, so it is never valid; from each left end you only need to extend at most 49 characters.

For each start, reset 7 counters and keep the number of distinct letters and the maximum frequency; move the end from start up to min(n, start+49)-1, update the three values for each added character, and add one to the answer whenever maximum <= distinct.

explanationEn:
## Approach

A valid substring has at most 7 kinds of characters, each appearing at most 7 times, so its length is at most 49. From each left end, extend at most 49 positions while maintaining the counts, the number of distinct characters, and the maximum frequency.

## Proof of correctness

If the length exceeds 49, the pigeonhole principle makes some letter appear at least 8 times, more than the at most 7 kinds of characters, so the substring cannot be valid. Enumerating lengths up to 49 covers every possibility, and comparing the two maintained counts follows the definition directly.

## Complexity

O(49n) time and O(7) space.
